chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But [He granted authority] over those who take him as their guardian and disobey His command.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/ally

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) clarification that Satan’s *sultan* (authority/power) is conditional, applying only to those who consciously follow his whispers and neglect divine commands. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle of free will, where spiritual subjugation is a result of human choice rather than absolute predestination, reinforcing the believer's capacity to resist through *tawhid* and obedience.
